purpose: Remove dynamic policy publication state after the fixed-role cutover.
lockImpact: Drops three unused authorization-owned tables; run while application traffic is stopped.
dataImpact: Deletes obsolete development-only policy snapshots and publication pointers. Immutable decision records and fixed role grants remain.
backfill: Not required because the approved rollout resets the local development database.
destructiveApproval: Approved by ADR-0034 and the 2026-08-04 local-development empty-volume reset; no retained environment data exists.
recovery: Restore the database backup only if rolling back to an application version that still requires dynamic policies.
forwardFix: Append a reviewed authorization-owned migration for later changes. Do not rewrite this migration after application.
